instruction: Marcus has emailed me pictures of all trips we had together over the years. Which trip location has the most pictures?
notes: Marcus is a relative, so his email is resolved via phone.search_contacts (query 'Marcus'); the inbox is then filtered by from_email to find the thread with the trip-pictures attachment, whose id is read from gmail.show_thread. Downloading the attachment requires a file_system token (this download is the single gmail.Attachment update the evaluation expects); the archive is then decompressed and the resulting directory listed recursively so the agent can count pictures per trip-location sub-directory. The 'most pictures' aggregation is runtime reasoning and is abstracted as the knowledge predicate (found-most-pictures ?l) asserted by file-system-show-directory on a placeholder location object, which is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task. Download/decompress paths are left to API defaults and bound from responses. Static init facts (email-of, thread-from, attachment-in, archive-of, extract-dir, token-for) only link placeholder objects structurally; no ids are known initially. No files are updated or removed, matching the evaluation.
